title: Beignets (Yeast-Raised Wheat Doughnuts, Northern Cameroon)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Sifted flour mixed by hand with yeast, sugar and warm water into a smooth dough, rested 2–3 hours until doubled or tripled in volume, then fried 5–10 minutes, turning constantly.
longDesc: p. 55 of the October 2023 recipe book. The page calls beignets ‘the number-one dish of the Cameroonian diet’, eaten hot with sautéed beans and/or porridge. The yeast is dissolved with the salt in part of the warm water and the sugar in the rest; a well is made in the sifted flour and mixed by hand to a smooth, homogeneous dough. It is covered and left 2–3 hours; after the rest the dough ‘will have doubled, even tripled, in volume’. The beignets are fried 5–10 minutes, turned constantly, and drained. The rise cue qualifies this yeast dough under the fermentation rule. Frying temperature, oil quantity and how the 250 ml of water is split are not printed.
ingredients: Vegetable oil for frying — quantity not printed
steps: Dissolve the yeast with the salt in part of the warm water, and the sugar in the rest.
Make a well in the sifted flour and mix by hand to a smooth, homogeneous dough.
Cover and leave 2–3 hours. The dough should have doubled, even tripled, in volume.
Fry the beignets 5–10 minutes, turning constantly.
chefTips: The printed cue is that the dough has doubled, even tripled, in volume.
Printed accompaniments: sautéed beans and/or porridge.
Frying temperature and oil quantity are not printed.
commonMistakes: Frying before the dough has risen.
Using cold water for the yeast.
healthBenefits: A fried wheat dough; calories come mainly from flour and frying oil.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe. The page calls beignets ‘the number-one dish of the Cameroonian diet’.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Beignets à base de farine de blé’ (p. 55). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 8, prep and cook splits are placeholders; rest 150 is the midpoint of the 2–3 hours printed. Ingredients TWO-PASS; method SINGLE-PASS (second reading agreed).
ABSENT: frying temperature; oil quantity; the split of the 250 ml between the yeast and sugar waters.
